sell.title: My shop

become.title: Sell on PAPA Market
become.lead: Open your own shop and sell to members across every district and assembly.
become.p1: Free to open. PAPA keeps a {fee}% fee only when you make a sale.
become.p2: Buyers pay PAPA first, so you never chase payment. Your money is held safely and paid to your mobile money or bank after delivery.
become.p3: Add products with photos, sizes and colours; run coupons and deals; follow every order from your phone.
become.p4: Buyers can follow your shop and are told when you add something new.
become.rule1: Sell only real items you have (or services you can deliver), with honest photos and prices.
become.rule2: Accept or cancel paid orders within 3 days, and give every buyer their hand-over code check.
become.rule3: No items that go against church teaching or Ghana law. Tech Admins may take down listings or suspend shops.
become.rule4: Refunds go back to the buyer through PAPA when an order is cancelled or a return is approved.

become.title: Become a PAPA rider
become.lead: Earn by delivering Market orders between members in your area.
become.p1: Choose the jobs you want; see the pay before you take one.
become.p2: Collect from the seller, deliver to the buyer, and check their 6-digit code.
become.p3: You're paid to your mobile money after the order is complete.
become.rule1: Only take jobs you can deliver the same day.
become.rule2: Hand over only after you check the buyer's code.
become.rule3: Be polite and honest; Tech Admins may pause or remove riders.
